scope: Single Atras button on practice launch

tests.node_command: node --test tests/practice-screens.test.mjs tests/practice-hub-reference.test.mjs tests/practice-nubi-access.test.mjs tests/practice-defaults.test.mjs tests/learning-ae-selector.test.mjs

verified: All three modalities open directly and all four levels remain selectable
All four stages are navigable and require genuine work before completion
Correct and incorrect choices use the canonical server-side key, not a default A
Written cases are editable and provide explicit review criteria without a score
New situations alternate format independently and change source case
Partial drafts require confirmation before replacement
Back navigation and page reload preserve session drafts and notes
Glossary search, calculator, notes, contextual agent and evidence dialog work
Escape closes the current evidence dialog without leaving practice
Expert support begins without an initial hint; hints are requested progressively
Local course images render with source attribution
Nubi remains accessible without a duplicate accessibility entry
320px viewport with enlarged text and simple visual mode has no horizontal overflow
High contrast has black option backgrounds and white text
Accessibility preferences and viewport were restored after testing
Launch has exactly one Atras button and subpages keep their existing return button
Station 2 title starts 8px below the AE selector edge; header height is about 74px
No browser console errors in the final loaded page

limits: Written review is an explicit criteria guide, not automated technical grading
Expert uses existing advanced source cases plus contrast, prioritization, risk and verification tasks
Drafts and notes last for the browser session on the current device, not a cross-device server archive
Visual interaction checks used one pilot course; shared catalog behavior was checked across all 45 courses
